meta.titleBowling: Bowling game — play 3D ten-pin bowling online — cv.cm
meta.descBowling: Play a free 3D bowling game in your browser: swipe or use the keys to roll, add spin to hook the ball, and bowl ten frames against the computer or on your own. Real scoring, works on phones.

bowling.q1: How do I roll the ball?
bowling.a1: Swipe up on the lane: the direction of the swipe sets the aim, its speed sets the power, and a curved swipe adds spin. Drag sideways first to move along the foul line. With a keyboard, use ← → to move, ↑ ↓ to turn the aim, hold Space and let go when the power meter is where you want it.
bowling.a2: Spin makes the ball hook once it leaves the oiled front part of the lane. Set it with the Spin slider or Q and E, or curve your swipe. Slower balls hook more. A good strike ball comes into the pocket between the head pin and the pin next to it.
bowling.a3: Ten frames of up to two balls. A strike (all ten with the first ball) scores 10 plus your next two balls; a spare (all ten with two balls) scores 10 plus your next ball. In the tenth frame a strike or spare earns bonus balls. A perfect game is 300.
bowling.q4: Can I play against the computer?
bowling.a4: Yes. Pick an easy, normal or hard computer opponent; it bowls its own frames after yours. Or choose Solo to bowl alone and chase your best score.
bowling.a5: Your best score and a game in progress stay in this browser, so you can come back to it. Nothing is uploaded.

bowling.lead: Bowl a game in three steps.
bowling.s1b: Drag sideways to move along the foul line and set some spin if you like.
bowling.s2b: Swipe up toward the pins, or hold Space and let go at the power you want.
bowling.s3b: Knock down what is left with the second ball. Strikes and spares earn bonus pins; the score sheet adds it all up.
